_comment: 「KhmerSabaiの 朝礼」ページ（content/articles/asakai_team.json）の 絵の うち、文字を 焼かない 4枚。台帳が 正で、教材JSONの prompt は その 写し（scripts/lib/image_ledger.mjs）。文字を 焼く 7枚は asakai_team_zukai.json、旅行者の 4枚は asakai_team_tabi.json。**しごとの 9枚は 撮らない**——朝礼の 画面と 同じ 絵（scripts/images/asakai_tasks.json・public/img/asakai/tasks/）を 使う。
style: Warm modern anime illustration, like a friendly Japanese educational manga — clean confident black linework, flat cel shading with gentle light, bright natural daylight, soft pastel palette of sky blue, cream and coral, rounded friendly shapes. A tidy contemporary Japanese software office with real desks, chairs, windows, plants, mugs and laptops. People are drawn as real human beings with natural proportions, warm friendly faces and exactly five fingers on each hand. Every picture is a REAL PLACE seen from a natural camera angle, and the subject FILLS THE WHOLE FRAME. This is a TEACHING picture, not a mood picture: what each person is doing must be readable from the picture alone.
noText: No text, no letters, no kanji, no kana, no numbers anywhere in the image. Screens, papers, whiteboards, books and signs are blank or show only soft abstract shapes and simple pictures. No watermark, no signature, no logo, no speech balloons, no floating symbols such as question marks, exclamation marks, arrows, light bulbs, stars or hearts.
negative: Never: photo-realistic rendering, harsh shadows, extra or merged fingers, distorted hands, dark or scary mood, angry or crying faces, watermarks, real company logos or brand marks of any kind, national flags, country outlines, maps with borders, tiny cluttered text, paragraphs of text, 3D render, flat vector icon art, pictograms floating on an empty background, robots, mascots. Payment cards, wallet icons and payment buttons carry ONLY plain abstract stripes and a small blank chip — never two overlapping coloured circles, never four coloured squares, never a swoosh, and never any mark or wordmark that resembles a real card brand or a real bank.

scenes.title: KhmerSabai 決済チームの 朝礼（表紙）
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: at nine in the morning the KhmerSabai payment team stands together and reports before starting work. A bright Japanese IT office in the morning, rows of desks with computers behind the team. Five colleagues stand in a loose half circle beside the desks, nobody sitting: the team leader Hendy — a slim man in his late twenties with short black slightly tousled hair, a navy two-button suit, a white shirt and a navy tie (follow his model sheet) stands at the left and opens the meeting with a small friendly nod; Okuda — a man in his mid twenties with wavy messy black hair, black thick-rimmed glasses and a dark green hoodie (follow his model sheet) and Nyam — a Southeast Asian man in his twenties with warm light-brown skin, short black hair swept up and back, and a coral knit cardigan over a cream shirt (follow his model sheet) stand in the middle holding mugs and small blank notebooks, listening; the two new engineers — a young Cambodian woman in her early twenties with warm light-brown skin, a round friendly face and black hair tied back in a low ponytail, wearing a mint-green blouse and beige trousers, and a young Cambodian man in his early twenties with warm light-brown skin, short black hair with a neat side part, wearing a light blue short-sleeved shirt and dark grey chinos; both wear a lanyard with a blank white card. NEVER GIVE THESE TWO THE SAME FACE — she is clearly a woman and he is clearly a man stand at the right, the woman speaking and holding a small blank notebook, the man beside her listening. Morning sunlight through a big window, plants nearby. Wide shot filling the frame.

scenes.title: 金曜日に 全部を つなぐ（ゴール）
scenes.where: content/articles/asakai_team.json ゴールの 帯の 下
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: on Friday the four separate parts are joined into one working flow, and next Monday the whole team tests it together. A bright office meeting corner in the afternoon. the team leader Hendy — a slim man in his late twenties with short black slightly tousled hair, a navy two-button suit, a white shirt and a navy tie (follow his model sheet), Okuda — a man in his mid twenties with wavy messy black hair, black thick-rimmed glasses and a dark green hoodie (follow his model sheet), Nyam — a Southeast Asian man in his twenties with warm light-brown skin, short black hair swept up and back, and a coral knit cardigan over a cream shirt (follow his model sheet) and the two new engineers — a young Cambodian woman in her early twenties with warm light-brown skin, a round friendly face and black hair tied back in a low ponytail, wearing a mint-green blouse and beige trousers, and a young Cambodian man in his early twenties with warm light-brown skin, short black hair with a neat side part, wearing a light blue short-sleeved shirt and dark grey chinos; both wear a lanyard with a blank white card. NEVER GIVE THESE TWO THE SAME FACE — she is clearly a woman and he is clearly a man stand around a low table, all five of them smiling and leaning in. On the table lie four large rounded cards like jigsaw pieces that they are fitting together into one long chain: the first card shows a simple order list drawing, the second a database cylinder drawing, the third a phone with a big button drawing, the fourth a plug and socket drawing. The last two pieces are being pressed together by two different hands, and the joins between the pieces are CLEARLY CLOSED with no gaps. No writing anywhere. Wide shot filling the frame.

scenes.title: 先週の 金曜日までに できた もの
scenes.where: content/articles/asakai_team.json あなたの 担当（先週の 金曜日）
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: by last Friday the two new engineers had finished the payment screen and the payment button. A bright office at the end of the week, low warm afternoon light. the two new engineers — a young Cambodian woman in her early twenties with warm light-brown skin, a round friendly face and black hair tied back in a low ponytail, wearing a mint-green blouse and beige trousers, and a young Cambodian man in his early twenties with warm light-brown skin, short black hair with a neat side part, wearing a light blue short-sleeved shirt and dark grey chinos; both wear a lanyard with a blank white card. NEVER GIVE THESE TWO THE SAME FACE — she is clearly a woman and he is clearly a man sit side by side at one desk in front of a large monitor, both looking at it with satisfied smiles; the woman rests one hand on the desk and the man points at the screen with one hand. The monitor shows a finished payment page: a summary panel with two soft grey placeholder bars, three payment method rows, and one big rounded sky-blue button at the bottom. No writing at all, no numbers. Wide shot filling the frame.

scenes.title: 大切：自分の 担当を、早く 報告する
scenes.where: content/articles/asakai_team.json 大切の 帯の 下
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: in the morning meeting you report about YOUR OWN work, and you say a problem as early as you can. A bright office in the morning. the new engineer — a young Cambodian man in his early twenties with warm light-brown skin, short black hair with a neat side part, a friendly open face, wearing a light blue short-sleeved shirt, dark grey chinos and a lanyard with a blank white card stands and speaks, one open hand held at chest height pointing back towards his own desk behind him, where a monitor shows a payment screen with one big rounded button. His other hand rests on a small blank notebook. the team leader Hendy — a slim man in his late twenties with short black slightly tousled hair, a navy two-button suit, a white shirt and a navy tie (follow his model sheet), Okuda — a man in his mid twenties with wavy messy black hair, black thick-rimmed glasses and a dark green hoodie (follow his model sheet) and Nyam — a Southeast Asian man in his twenties with warm light-brown skin, short black hair swept up and back, and a coral knit cardigan over a cream shirt (follow his model sheet) stand facing him in a half circle, listening with calm friendly nods — NOBODY looks angry, nobody looks down on anyone. No writing at all, no numbers. Wide shot filling the frame.
